Package org.uma.evolver.algorithm.rvea

Class BaseRVEA<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.algorithm.rvea.BaseRVEA<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the type of solutions handled by this algorithm
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseLevelAlgorithm<S>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DoubleRVEA
public abstract class BaseRVEA<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>> extends Object implements BaseLevelAlgorithm<S>
Abstract base class for configurable RVEA (Reference Vector Guided Evolutionary Algorithm) implementations, covering RVEA, RVEA* and iRVEA.

Follows the same template-method pattern as BaseNSGAII. The configurable components, drawn from a ParameterSpace, are the initialisation strategy, the variation (crossover and mutation), the mating selection (random or tournament) and the replacement, whose value selects the variant: rvea, rveaStar or iRVEA, with the global sub-parameters alpha and fr and, for iRVEA, numberOfSubregions, lateStageFraction and epsilonKappa. The names and values are those of jMetal's AutoRVEA.

The population size must equal the number of reference vectors. They are given either as a list, or as a directory of weight vector files (W<objectives>D_<populationSize>.dat, as in MOEA/D), read for each problem; the second form allows training sets whose problems have different numbers of objectives. RVEA requires unconstrained problems and termination by number of evaluations.
